actions.government_body: South Carolina Governor / South Carolina Department of Commerce
actions.summary: Google announced two new Dorchester County data center campuses at Pine Hill Business Campus in Ridgeville and Winding Woods Commerce Park in St. George as part of a $2 billion Dorchester County investment.
Dorchester County Economic Development stated Google's two Dorchester County data center campuses were under active construction.

actions.government_body: Public Service Commission of South Carolina
actions.summary: Dominion reported Dawson Substation Phase 1 energized on 2025-10-07, Phase 2 substantially complete except protection checkouts, and the project completion date extended to 2026-12-31 due to pole delivery delays.

sources.match_reason: Official South Carolina and Dorchester County sources identify Google's Ridgeville campus at Pine Hill Business Campus; PSC filings tie Project Dawson / Mallard, LLC to parcels near Research Center Drive in Ridgeville.

contradictions.notes: The seed/SKILL one-line location listed Berkeley County, but official South Carolina, Dorchester County, Google, and PSC sources place the Ridgeville/Pine Hill Business Campus project in Dorchester County. Berkeley County references in official announcements refer to Google's separate Moncks Corner expansion.
PSC filings confirm substantial load and 230 kV service infrastructure, but public contract capacity values are redacted; no reliable MW capacity was found.
